import diskcache, functools, hashlib

cache = diskcache.Cache({{cache_dir}})

@functools.wraps({{embed_fn}})
def cached_embed(text):
    k = hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest()
    if k in cache: return cache[k]
    v = {{embed_fn}}(text)
    cache[k] = v
    return v
summary_zh: diskcache 包 embed 函數，hash 命中直接回傳
